name: com.codebridge.livelink
description: Drive the servos of an ESP32 or Arduino from a Unity scene, and see the board's feedback in the scene. Talks to codebridge-livelink over a local WebSocket: the link keeps every joint inside its limits and speed, and stops the arm when Unity goes away.

samples.description: A three-joint arm built from primitives, with sliders, a ghost that shows where the real servos are, and a stop key.
